split_policy.sealed_query_budget_and_rotation: Must be fixed before release campaign

measurement_policy.reference_camera_alignment: Frozen before candidate evaluation; estimated and measured poses reported separately
measurement_policy.rgb: 8-bit RGB sRGB [0,1], no automatic resize/exposure fit; source-driven fixed crops
measurement_policy.psnr: -10 log10 RGB MSE; capped at 120 dB for exact-match serialization
measurement_policy.ssim: 11x11 Gaussian sigma 1.5, population covariance, valid window, channel mean
measurement_policy.lpips: Must pin network/weights/preprocessing; collector not yet connected
measurement_policy.depth: Metres, independent reference required; missing predicted depth penalized separately
measurement_policy.instances: All structures, objects and parts: identity, category, pose, dimensions, material labels, parent, spatial relations, state and affordance labels. Automatic source graph extraction remains pending.
measurement_policy.temporal: State/visibility/motion-compensated consistency required; collector not yet connected
measurement_policy.physics: Independent raw contact, joint, collision and negative-control probes required
measurement_policy.tasks: Predeclared seeds and perturbations, all failures retained, success-rate confidence interval
measurement_policy.cost: Separate wall time, GPU time, token usage, cached tokens, retries and provider cost; missing is null
measurement_policy.thresholds: Calibrate by asset/task and capture domain; inherited 22dB/5cm are development references only
